prior_exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Checked the current GitHub main data/reference/ucr_courses_enriched.xlsx (151 course rows), including profiles, descriptions, prerequisites and planned semester offerings. prior_exception.reason: The Radboud degree is an integrated molecular biology AND chemistry programme. Its compulsory first year already includes atoms and molecules, analytical chemistry and a chemical-analysis lab, organic chemistry and synthesis lab, biochemistry and its lab, thermodynamics, cell biophysics and a molecular-sciences lab. The later compulsory core deepens organic, inorganic and analytical chemistry, crystal structure, biomolecular mechanisms and structural bioinformatics, then requires a supervised 12-EC research internship. UCR offers valuable molecular-cell and biomedical courses but lacks a sequence in organic/inorganic/analytical/physical chemistry, molecular spectroscopy and synthesis, and has only one broad life-science laboratory course. A 24-course UCR schedule could sustain biomedical biology with data methods, but it would omit the defining chemistry and multi-lab spine and would misrepresent equivalence to this molecular-science degree.
prior_exception.curriculumContext: The current adopted 2026–27 Faculty of Science EER, rather than the loosely grouped prospective year-three thematic examples, controls the 180-EC reconstruction. Its differentiation phase is restricted and its research internship is mandatory. The exception follows assessment of the closest 24-course molecular/biomedical possibility against the entire current UCR enriched course database.
prior_exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Read all 151 current enriched UCR course rows with descriptions, profiles, semester availability and prerequisites. HCBGATE101 Foundation of Life, Health & Biomedicine, HCBLIFE211 Molecular Cell Biology, HCBLIFE213 Biochemistry, HCBLIFE214 Life Science Laboratory, HCBLIFE311 Molecular Pathology & Genetics and HCBBIOM312 Infection & Immunity cover genuine biological and biomedical parts. DISGATE101 Introduction to Programming, DISGATE102 Mathematical Methods, DISDATA111 Introduction to Data Science and BENGATE102 Research Methods & Statistics can support quantitative work. HCBLIFE214 introduces biochemical and molecular lab techniques, but no available courses provide the formally required analytical-chemistry lab, organic synthesis laboratories, physical chemistry/thermodynamics, spectroscopy or a sustained organic/inorganic chemistry progression. The only feasible alternative would be a different biomedical/data curriculum, so no 24-course closest UCR degree is encoded.

prior_exception.reason: Radboud Natural Sciences teaches physics, chemistry, (molecular) biology and mathematics together. The compulsory first year includes chemical analysis and lab, organic chemistry and synthesis lab, atoms and molecules, biochemistry, thermodynamics, mechanics and lab, and electromagnetism; the shared later core adds quantum mechanics and vector calculus. The selected physical-chemistry route requires advanced mechanics, electromagnetism, spectroscopy, chemical bonding and physical organic chemistry. UCR has viable biology, environmental science, data and mathematics courses, but it has no taught sequence in chemistry or core mechanics/electromagnetism/quantum physics. Its few relevant biochemistry and broad life-science lab offerings cannot stand in for the missing experimental chemistry and physics. A 24-course environmental/biomedical/data curriculum would be a different degree, not a faithful closest response to this exact target.
prior_exception.curriculumContext: The adopted 2026–27 EER establishes a coherent 180-EC first-listed Physical Chemistry route; the 39-EC restricted specialisation choice and 6-EC open free space are kept separate. All three specialisations share a mandatory physics/chemistry core, so selecting Biophysics or Biochemistry would not fix the substantive UCR gap.
prior_exception.ucrCourseEvidence: Read all 151 rows of data/reference/ucr_courses_enriched.xlsx on the current GitHub main version, including descriptions, outline-based profiles, disciplines, prerequisites and 2026–29 availability. HCBGATE101 Foundation of Life, Health & Biomedicine, HCBLIFE213 Biochemistry and HCBLIFE214 Life Science Laboratory address biology and a limited molecular lab; DISGATE102 Mathematical Methods, DISMATH211 Linear Algebra, DISMATH214 Advanced Calculus and DISGATE101 Introduction to Programming address some mathematical and computational techniques. ENSSUST111 Climate Change, ENSENVI111 Dynamic Earth and ENSENVI213 Earth System Science Tools address environmental systems. No UCR courses supply first-year organic chemistry, chemical analysis and synthesis labs, mechanics and electromagnetism, nor a progressive quantum/physical-chemistry and advanced physics route. An academically coherent 24-course arrangement could draw on the cited areas but would omit the external degree’s defining mandatory laboratory and disciplinary spine.
